environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a private subnet with a NAT Gateway providing internet egress. The task role has broad sts:AssumeRole permissions (Resource: '*'). Service is accessible via internal ALB on port 8080. VPC has standard routing: private subnet -> NAT GW -> IGW. Security group allows inbound from VPC CIDR on port 8080. Any compromised container in the VPC can call the credential endpoint and exfiltrate the obtained credentials to an external C2 server via the NAT gateway.

config.vpc_config: private subnet with NAT Gateway, route 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-gw
